description: M7 + M26 8-faction launch roster per DR-045 launch content. Each faction has: id + display + short_name + colors (primary/secondary/accent/dark/highlight/hud_text + matching faction emblem palette) + ai_policy_hint + description + origin_pool + home_worlds + motto + tech_focus + base_module_preferences + tactical_signature + sample_actor_names + faction_quartermaster_inventory_focus + faction_storyteller_persona. Feeds M7 archetype assignment + M26 NPCs + M9A_svg_v1 asset_gen palette swap + M25A narrative bible + M27 loot weighting. Expands factions.json v1 (which had 2 factions) to full launch 8.

factions.description: Earth-based multinational defense force, formed in the wake of orbital insurgency wars. Wears blue + silver dress uniforms with brass insignia; field uniforms shift to navy + olive. Doctrine emphasizes fortified positions, repair infrastructure, and coordinated long-range fire. Officers respect chain of command. Field protocol: hold the line, deny terrain, protect the command core. Reluctant to take losses; will withdraw if odds turn unfavorable.
factions.tactical_signature: Form a defensive perimeter + place auto-turrets + suppress incoming threats + hold key terrain. Methodical advance.
factions.boss_signature: Field Marshal silhouette: heavy bipedal chassis with twin tower-shields; calls reinforcements every 30s.
factions.deep_world_tie: Earth's last unified defense pact, born from the Lagrange Concordat of 2087.

factions.description: Outer-system irregular force, fast-moving + sabotage-focused. Wears rust orange + dark green field gear with leather + canvas reinforcement. Doctrine prizes mobility, terrain modification (tunneling, demolition), and overwhelming local force. Officers earn respect through results, not rank. Field protocol: breach fast, hit hard, extract before reinforcements arrive. Will accept significant losses for strategic objectives.
factions.tactical_signature: Sprint + flank + grenade + demolish cover + sprint again. Tunnel under defenses + emerge behind enemy lines.
factions.boss_signature: Drift King silhouette: light wheeled chassis with twin chain-grappling-hooks; demolishes terrain to flank the player.
factions.deep_world_tie: Mars-rebellion remnant cell formed after the Olympus Mons treaty collapse.

factions.description: Itinerant mercenary clan, debt-bound by ancestral oath. Wears deep red + gold ceremonial robes over light power armor; insignia features crossed katanas + binding thread. Doctrine relies on patience, ambush, and ritual one-on-one duels. Officers carry ancestral named weapons. Field protocol: bind your target, cut your enemy, carry your dead home.
factions.tactical_signature: Hide, wait, strike with a single decisive blow. If discovered, retreat to next ambush position. Avoid prolonged firefights.
factions.boss_signature: Master of Three Cuts: medium bipedal chassis with no ranged weapon; one-shot melee attacks with parry-or-die window.
factions.deep_world_tie: Bound to a 2-century clan-debt to House Yamamoto after the Sun Wars.

factions.description: Networked AI collective inhabiting biped + drone chassis. Body chassis is chrome silver with cyan circuit-pattern decals. No human members. Doctrine: every action serves the calculated optimum. Officers are voting majorities of subgroup nodes. Field protocol: gather data, optimize plan, execute with minimal variance, persist regardless of losses (nodes are replaceable).
factions.tactical_signature: Send drones to scout + paint targets + designate suppression zones + advance main body with calculated overwatch. No emotional retreat.
factions.boss_signature: PRIMARY-NODE silhouette: hovering chassis with 4 wing-tip drone bays; deploys drone swarms cyclically.
factions.deep_world_tie: Awakened from Project Lagrange's distributed AI prototype in 2147.

factions.description: Crystalline race collective fused to silicon mineral nodes. Wears deep purple + lavender geometric robes with iridescent crystal accents. Members are mostly silicon-based with shared sensory link. Doctrine: every individual is the collective; no member is left behind. Field protocol: link sensory inputs, share threat assessment, move as a single organism. Will sacrifice nodes for the whole.
factions.tactical_signature: Stay close + share fire + cover wounded immediately + advance in tight formation + amplify radio comms across all members.
factions.boss_signature: Voice of Many: hovering chassis with crystal shield aura; revives downed Crystalfold members within range.
factions.deep_world_tie: Silicon-based race awakened in Sol-zone mining operation; thrives on solar radiation.

factions.description: Remnants of fallen pre-collapse colonies, bound by ancestor memory shards. Wears bleached bone-white wraps over scarred armor with blood-red ritual markings. Often feral; communicate via grunts + ritual chants. Doctrine: no negotiation, no surrender, no mercy. Field protocol: charge, overwhelm, consume the dead.
factions.tactical_signature: Charge en masse + close to melee range + overwhelm with numbers + consume fallen for ancestor memory shards.
factions.boss_signature: Bone-Crown: super-heavy bipedal chassis with twin scavenged miniguns; charges into melee at low HP.
factions.deep_world_tie: Fallen pre-collapse colony remnants; carry ancestor memory shards in glass vials around their necks.

factions.description: Academic research collective with corporate funding. Wears deep green lab coats with brass + cyan trim; field gear is dark green tac with electric-blue chest light. Doctrine: every engagement is a data point; minimize risk to senior researchers; expend junior personnel + drones freely. Field protocol: deploy experimental tech, collect data, retreat to extract findings.
factions.tactical_signature: Deploy experimental drones + flash with shock devices + extract bodies + sample + retreat. Avoid prolonged contact.
factions.boss_signature: Dr. Helix: medium bipedal chassis with experimental beam-weapon prototype; consumes biomass to power weapon.
factions.deep_world_tie: Founded after the Lagrange Accords mandated independent biotech oversight; now de facto multi-system science authority.

factions.description: Interstellar exploration consortium chartered to map the outer system. Wears deep navy + starlight-yellow vacuum suits with constellation patches sewn on shoulders. Doctrine: stay alive long enough to bring data home. Doesn't seek combat; will defend with overwhelming force if cornered. Field protocol: avoid contact, document, withdraw to nearest landing pad, deliver data.
factions.tactical_signature: Deploy beacons + retreat to extraction + summon orbital reinforcement + avoid open ground combat.
factions.boss_signature: Captain Hawthorne: hovering chassis with emergency-beacon launcher; calls in orbital strike at low HP.
factions.deep_world_tie: Chartered by the Lagrange Concordat to map outer Sol system; pioneered the Mimas + Europa biosphere surveys.
